gloss: gradually; in due course; bit by bit

definitions.gloss: gradually; in due course; bit by bit
definitions.explanation: Little by little over time, or at a later point when the time is right. Common in the phrase {追々|おいおい}{説明|せつめい}します 'I'll explain as we go along'.

examples.japanese: {追々|おいおい}⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: You'll get used to it bit by bit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{追々|おいおい}⟦{説明|せつめい}します→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll explain the details as we go along.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{追々|おいおい}⟦{覚|おぼ}えて→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧いけば⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The new job is hard, but you can learn it gradually.

notes:
Often written in hiragana, おいおい.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}→徐々：03082_jojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: gradually — neutral, for steady change
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: little by little — the everyday phrase
- ⟦そのうち→そのうち：00380_sonouchi⟧: sooner or later — vaguer about the timing

WATCH OUT:
The same sound おいおい, written only in kana, is also loud crying (おいおい⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧) and the call 'hey, hey!'. Context makes the meaning clear: {追々|おいおい} modifies verbs of learning, explaining, or getting used to something.
